paths.description: Homepage and global shell: primary discovery entry, preferences, navigation, performance, privacy, metadata, and memory. Represents global marketplace chrome.
Top games listing: catalog/filter archetype and dense responsive card grid.
Search results for horror: primary search journey, filters, tags, project results, dialog/details semantics.
Representative creator game detail: content, creator theming, download CTA, embeds, comments, media performance.
Free-game purchase/download choice: core-flow continuity, pricing clarity, form semantics, files, and payment options.
Authentication entry: attempted inspection of permissions and passkey/password behavior.
HTTP failure and recovery state using a deliberately invalid route.

findings.summary: The main marketplace UI stays light when the user requests dark mode.
findings.evidence: Paired screenshots under default and prefers-color-scheme: dark are visually identical, and the probe found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and retint surfaces, text, controls, and browser UI with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Animated GIF promotions continue without a reduced-motion alternative.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion probe found no prefers-reduced-motion rule while the image audit found animated GIF assets; the reduced-motion video records the same promotional animation surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide static poster alternatives or replace GIFs with controllable media, and suppress non-essential animation under prefers-reduced-motion.

findings.summary: Many text and control combinations fail contrast, with no high-contrast adaptation.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast screenshot does not retint the page; the probe found no prefers-contrast/forced-colors CSS and Lighthouse reported 104 contrast failures on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct base contrast first, then add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations without suppressing system colors.

findings.summary: Route changes use abrupt full-document swaps.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probes across homepage, listing, search, and detail found no view-transition-name, ::view-transition, or @view-transition usage despite frequent browse-to-detail navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document View Transitions for same-origin marketplace routes, with reduced-motion fallbacks.

findings.summary: Long listing pages provide static chrome with no scroll-position feedback.
findings.evidence: The mobile listing is 5,212 CSS pixels tall and the detail page is 11,167 pixels tall, while probes found no scroll-state query or progress/position feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight progress/return affordance where it improves orientation on long pages.

findings.summary: Menus and filter overlays do not use CSS anchor positioning.
findings.evidence: The rendered interfaces contain header menus and filtering controls, but probes found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Attach transient menus to their triggers with CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks.

findings.summary: A persistent YouTube promotion consumes the bottom of the mobile viewport.
findings.evidence: The mobile homepage screenshot shows a fixed YouTube subscribe bar covering content at the bottom with no visible dismiss control.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the fixed promotion, make it non-overlapping inline content, or provide a clear persistent dismiss action.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-only rather than component-aware.
findings.evidence: All four representative probes found no @container/container-type usage, even though cards, filters, and marketplace modules are reused in varied widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable cards/filter modules while preserving existing media-query fallbacks.

findings.summary: Many controls are too small for reliable touch input.
findings.evidence: The focus/target probe found 34 of the first 40 homepage targets under 44px in at least one dimension; many links are 17–32px tall, and Lighthouse reported target-size failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target boxes or spacing to at least 44×44 CSS px for primary controls and dense icon/action links, while retaining visible focus.

findings.summary: The representative game detail template has very poor lab LCP and unstable loading.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 29.9s LCP and 0.284 CLS on the selected game detail page; listing LCP was also 4.2s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the detail hero/LCP resource, reserve media space, and defer YouTube and below-fold work until needed.

findings.summary: Game detail media lacks dimensions and shifts during load.
findings.evidence: The detail image audit found all 7 images missing width/height; Lighthouse measured CLS 0.284 and identified a layout-shift culprit.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio on creator media and embeds before content loads.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking assets and weak LCP discovery delay primary content.
findings.evidence: The HAR identifies main.css and synchronous lib.min.js/index.min.js as parser-inserted high-priority candidates; Lighthouse flags LCP discovery and dependency-tree issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, split route-specific code, and make the LCP image discoverable and prioritized without over-preloading.

findings.summary: Analytics and shared JavaScript consume a disproportionate share of the initial load.
findings.evidence: The homepage transfers 793KB; 289KB is script, including 158KB for Google Tag Manager, before a user interacts.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay analytics until consent/idle where appropriate, trim shared bundles, and load route-specific dependencies conditionally.

findings.summary: Core marketplace cards and controls lack accessible alternatives.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found unnamed buttons, 14 homepage images without alt, 16 unnamed links, and an unnamed SVG; listing/detail templates add dozens more. The probes also found no main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Give functional images/links/buttons accurate names, use empty alt only for truly decorative images, title iframes, and expose semantic landmarks.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails widely across the marketplace.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reported 104 contrast failures on home, 51 on listing, and 3 on the creator detail template.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text, muted metadata, badges, and controls to meet WCAG contrast in every creator theme state.

findings.summary: Representative pages lack landmark structure.
findings.evidence: The DOM probes found zero main, nav, header, or footer semantic landmarks on home, listing, search, and detail. Lighthouse fails landmark-one-main on each audited template.
findings.suggestedFix: Use header/nav/main/footer landmarks and preserve the existing visible focus behavior and skip link destination.

findings.summary: Touch-target sizing prevents a comparable mobile experience.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 11 target-size failures on home, 9 on listing, and 112 on detail; probes show many 16–35px-high controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive target size/spacing and retest at narrow viewport and 200% zoom.

findings.summary: Creator imagery is delivered without dimensions and at incorrect aspect ratios.
findings.evidence: The detail image audit found 7/7 images without dimensions and Lighthouse found 5 images displayed at incorrect aspect ratio.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve authored aspect ratios, provide dimensions, and use responsive image sources for creator assets.

findings.summary: The game detail template logs a browser inspector issue.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse best-practices scored the detail template 0.92 and reported one inspector issue, while home and listing scored 1.0.
findings.suggestedFix: Inspect and resolve the reported DevTools issue on embedded/creator content, then rerun Lighthouse.

findings.summary: Key indexable marketplace templates omit self-referencing canonicals.
findings.evidence: Homepage and /games probes found no canonical URL, while the purchase page does provide one; robots and sitemap otherwise align and return successful statuses.
findings.suggestedFix: Add stable self-referencing canonical links to indexable home/listing templates and keep query/filter policy consistent with robots.

findings.summary: Baseline transport defenses are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive confirms HTTPS and nosniff/X-Frame-Options, but no Content-Security-Policy or Strict-Transport-Security; analytics cookies are also set without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, enable HSTS after subdomain validation, and mark all HTTPS cookies Secure with appropriate SameSite values.

findings.summary: Analytics loads immediately and creates long-lived identifiers.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence found Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics; two analytics cookies are non-Secure, SameSite=None, and live 400 days. GTM alone transfers 158KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize analytics, shorten retention, obtain consent where required, and defer/batch telemetry rather than loading it on every initial view.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy headers are incomplete or dated.
findings.evidence: Headers show no HSTS, CSP, or Permissions-Policy; Referrer-Policy is no-referrer-when-downgrade rather than a stricter modern policy. Clickjacking protection and nosniff are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, a scoped Permissions-Policy, strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter referrer policy, and CSP frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: The global marketplace does not declare direction or expose logical-layout CSS in audited templates.
findings.evidence: All pages declare lang=en but no explicit dir; probes found no logical-property rules in accessible styles, while the platform exposes translations and serves global content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set direction explicitly where locale determines it and migrate reusable layout spacing/positioning to logical properties, testing an RTL locale.

findings.summary: Marketplace and creator images are frequently oversized or delivered in legacy formats.
findings.evidence: Home has 52 below-fold images without lazy loading, 61 without srcset, and animated GIF/JPEG/PNG assets; detail serves a 2500px PNG at 600px and all seven images are legacy formats.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, responsive srcset/sizes, dimensions, and lazy loading for below-fold media; replace GIF motion with efficient controllable media.

findings.summary: Third-party analytics and promotional media use substantial resources before interaction.
findings.evidence: The homepage transfers 793KB; GTM is the largest single response at 158KB and two GIFs total about 180KB, with analytics active immediately.
findings.suggestedFix: Budget third-party code, defer analytics and video promotional resources, and replace GIFs with efficient, user-controlled formats.

taskList.title: Repair accessible names, contrast, landmarks, and target sizing across shared marketplace components
Fix the game-detail LCP/CLS path and reserve all creator media space
Deploy CSP/HSTS/Permissions-Policy and secure analytics cookies
Add user-preference theming, reduced-motion media alternatives, and high-contrast support
Optimize responsive images/GIFs and defer analytics/third-party work
Remove or make the fixed mobile YouTube promotion dismissible and non-overlapping
Adopt component queries and resilient modern navigation positioning/transitions
Add canonical URLs and improve international direction/logical layout readiness
Resolve the creator-detail DevTools inspector issue
